'''Weave armor''' was a model of armor worn by military units throughout the [[Old Republic era]]. It was a flexible yet durable suit of armor that provided excellent protection to the wearer from [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]], while restricting movement by only a small amount. Weave armor was favored by warriors whose combat style called for fast and flexible movements, like duelists and [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiators]].
